subject.title: [Feature]: Semantic Message Aggregation: merge rapid-fire short messages and split multi-topic long messages

question: Should OpenClaw add semantic topic splitting and adaptive aggregation as a core/session-ingress capability, or keep fixed inbound debounce plus narrower follow-up trackers as the supported path?
rationale: The remaining request changes cross-channel turn boundaries and adds config/API surface, which repository policy treats as product- and compatibility-sensitive rather than an automatic repair.

options.title: Design Generic Ingress Contract
options.body: Approve one opt-in generic ingress/bundle contract, preserve current defaults, and keep semantic splitting behind explicit schema, docs, and representative channel tests.

options.title: Defer Semantic Splitting
options.body: Keep this issue as product backlog, let the adaptive timing tracker own debounce changes, and avoid adding semantic topic analysis until the desired transcript/session model is clearer.

options.title: Close As Out Of Scope
options.body: Decide that fixed debounce is the supported core answer and ask semantic preprocessing experiments to live in a plugin or external integration if a sufficient ingress API exists.

recommendation.title: Design Generic Ingress Contract
recommendation.body: Approve one opt-in generic ingress/bundle contract, preserve current defaults, and keep semantic splitting behind explicit schema, docs, and representative channel tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history across shared inbound debounce policy, ordering fixes, and prior product-review context for this area.
